findings.summary: S12.3 unmet: the engine-side mutation gate is unreachable in the assembled production pipeline. build_pipeline is the only production construction site of AgentRunStageActor and never sets mutation_inputs; DevelopmentConfig has no field to supply one, and grep over src/ finds no assignment to mutation_inputs anywhere. _with_final_review_mutations therefore early-returns on `provider is None` for every real run, so no final_review stage executes mutations or produces a receipt. This is the 'exported but never invoked' recurrence that S12.3 was explicitly tightened to stop; only test fixtures pass mutation_inputs in.

S12.3 receipt artifact unmet: the mutation receipt never reaches review.json or any sidecar artifact, so the 'final_review produces the receipt / the gate only verifies it' loop is open. dd_materializer.request() forwards only declared['review_result'], narrowed by review_actor_result() to the eleven keys review-result.schema.json admits; the sibling 'mutation_receipt' key set by _with_final_review_mutations is not forwarded at all, and dd_pipeline then replaces outcome.receipt with the sealer's receipt, discarding it from run state too. Nothing writes it to disk, so the line-side duty_mutation_receipt can never obtain a real receipt in production.

S12.5 unmet in the sealed artifact: checked_items is stripped before sealing, so rc/rf review.json still carry no '已核验项' list. review_actor_result() filters the reviewer's declared result to review_result_fields(), read from the vendored review-result.schema.json whose eleven properties and additionalProperties:false were left unchanged. The ingest-side enforcement (validate_review_receipt in _outcome_from) and the updated prompt do make the reviewer emit the field, but it is dropped at the materializer boundary, so the durable receipt still lacks the record of what was checked -- the exact failure mode S12.5's rationale cites, and the acceptance criterion requires the field to be present in the review.json artifact itself.

The D8 equivalence assertion passes vacuously with respect to its purpose. static_call_reachable walks a single module's AST, so act -> _with_final_review_mutations -> execute_final_review_mutations is statically reachable inside dd_actors.py while the assembled pipeline leaves mutation_inputs None and the mechanism is runtime-inert. Because M3 cannot be exercised on a real machine, this assertion was the only mechanical guard that the mechanism is genuinely connected; as written it goes green while the property it substitutes for is false, and it should assert over the production assembly (build_pipeline supplying the provider), not over one module's call graph.

Verification-method caveat, recorded rather than passed over silently: this reviewer role has read-only file inspection and no shell/Git execution, so the mandated `git diff --exit-code a470dfcc 248aa2b3 -- . ':(exclude).dev-dispatch'` product-consistency check was not executed and no exit code is claimed for it. Product consistency was assessed by content inspection of the worktree at HEAD, which showed the expected metadata-only review artifact under .dev-dispatch/reviews/ and no evidence of a product-file change between the two commits. The REJECT above rests on the product code as read at a470dfcc, not on this check.
